item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei ordered accountability for torture, arbitrary detention, disappearances, or extrajudicial killing. I also did not find evidence of a general policy change that would materially reduce political imprisonment or exemplary punishment.
